The scholar who first theorized the pulmonary circulation was **Ibn al‑Nafis** (ʿAlāʾ al‑Dīn Abū al‑Ḥasan ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥazm al‑Qarāšī).  According to modern biographical sources:

| Year | Event |
|------|-------|
| **1213 CE** | Born in Damascus |
| **1288–1289 CE** | Died in Cairo |

Thus, Ibn al‑Nafis lived for roughly **75 years** (from 1213 to 1288/1289).
